scope: Posthoc one-file static diagnostic. Does not change frozen functional scores or selection rule; not a whole-repository CI verdict. All seven snapshots use the same installed basedpyright1.39.7 and interpreter with network denied. CI uses a separately provisioned gate environment and codebase-wide budgets; these counts do not establish its outcome.
comparisonMethod: Additional diagnostics are a multiset difference by exact rule and message versus the historical base; line numbers describe each candidate and are not used for matching.
